description_en: Converts an instance from pay-as-you-go to subscription billing
description_zh: 调用ConvertInstance将实例从按量收费转为包年包月收费
name: ConvertInstance

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription period. Valid values:
year: year.
month: month
parameters.help_zh:
订购的周期单位
year：年，
month：月
parameters.name: pricing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. Valid values:
If PricingCycle is set to year, the value ranges from 1 to 3.
If PricingCycle is set to month, the value ranges from 1 to 9
parameters.help_zh:
订购的周期数量
PricingCycle=year时，取值1-3；
PricingCycle=month时，取值1-9
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

Prepaid: subscription.
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
实例的计费类型，返回值：

Prepaid：包年包月。
Postpaid：按量付费
parameters.name: pay_type
